modules.module_title: Select the site and plan the construction activities

pcs.pc_description: select an appropriate site with adequate and appropriate vegetation, i.e. grass and plants, to feed pigs
ensure the site is at an appropriate distance from dwellings, factories, dairies, poultry farms, food grains storage, etc.
check the site has an adequate and reliable water supply
check that the site does not experience extended exposure to sunlight, waterlogging and has proximity to the relevant markets for procuring the relevant inputs and marketing pigs
plan the construction activities at the pig farm, including an appropriate number of pens to facilitate breeding and fattening activities

modules.module_title: Coordinate the pig farm construction activities

pcs.pc_description: arrange the required tools, equipment and material, e.g. wood, bamboo sticks, concrete, stone slabs, bricks, etc., for the construction activities
assist in the installation of durable and strong fences around the pig farm to prevent the escaping of pigs
coordinate with the relevant expert for the construction of pigsty and pig arks
ensure concrete and sloping floor of the recommended thickness in the pigsty, and smooth walls for the easy removal of animal waste and thorough cleaning
install appropriate bedding in the pig arks for the comfortable sleeping of pigs
ensure adequate space and ventilation for easy maintenance and healthy growth of pigs, considering the number of pigs planned at the farm
ensure the construction of drainage channels to drain out animal waste from the farm
set up feeders and water troughs at appropriate locations to ensure their easy accessibility to the pigs and cleaners/attendants
ensure appropriate arrangements at the farm to protect pigs from adverse weather, i.e. roofing and shading of weather-proof material

pcs.pc_description: determine the nutritional needs of pigs based on the relevant factors, such as age, weight, growth pattern, etc.
select the appropriate feed to meet the nutritional requirements of pigs, e.g. maize, wheat bran, soybean meal, rice bran, mustard oil cake, household scrape/ food waste, etc.
prepare the pig feed using the recommended ingredients to meet the varied nutritional needs of pigs
maintain the recommended ratio of concentrated feed
ensure the household scraps are appropriately treated before feeding to pigs, e.g. boiling the leftover meat before feeding the pigs with them
feed the pigs following the recommended feeding schedule according to their age and stages of growth
follow the recommended health and hygiene standards while preparing the pig feed and feeding the pigs
use the appropriate feeders and water troughs to feed and water pigs, maintaining the cleanliness of feeders and water troughs to prevent the spread of food-borne diseases in pigs
carry out creep feeding and fostering in piglets when necessary
ensure to water pigs with the recommended quantity of fresh and clean water according to their need and prevailing weather conditions
monitor pigs during their feeding and identify pigs not feeding or feeding inadequately
follow the appropriate measures to ensure optimum feeding by pigs according to their nutritional requirements or coordinate with a veterinarian to resolve feeding issues in pigs
maintain cleanliness in the feed/feed ingredient storage and apply the appropriate pesticides to prevent pest/rodent infestations
follow the appropriate preventive measures to protect the pigs from parasites and relevant diseases
monitor the pigs for signs of diseases and disorders, e.g. loss of appetite, rapid breathing, high body temperature, etc.
treat the pigs for common diseases and disorders with the appropriate medication
coordinate with a veterinarian for the treatment of diseases and disorders, as required
carry out deworming following the recommended deworming schedule
ensure appropriate vaccination for pigs as per the applicable vaccination schedule
follow the appropriate bio-security procedures to control the spread of zoonotic diseases among the pigs
ensure that pigs are not scavenging or feeding on unhygienic items
follow the appropriate measures to protect piglets from common health issues and minimize mortality among them
maintain the cleanliness of pigs by washing them regularly using the appropriate animal care products
use the appropriate Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) in the pig farm operations to ensure self-protection from the relevant health and safety hazards
identify the relevant buyers and negotiate with them to secure a profitable price
arrange an appropriate mode of transport to deliver pigs safely and in hygienic condition to the buyers
process the payments using the appropriate e-payment methods
maintain the relevant manual and electronic records

coordinate with a veterinarian to check the health of the fatteners being procured

modules.module_title: Perform nutrient and health management of fatteners

pcs.pc_description: ensure hygienic and safe fattening pens for the procured fatteners with appropriate bedding for them
maintain the appropriate temperature in the fattening pens and arrange hog wallows as appropriate
prepare and feed the fatteners with the appropriate feed containing the necessary nutrients for their healthy growth and fattening
monitor the fatteners during feeding to ensure their optimum feeding and follow the appropriate measures to minimize the wastage of feed
conduct regular inspections of the fatteners and identify the signs of diseases, disorders, parasitic infections, and injuries
treat the fatteners by providing them appropriate treatment or coordinate with a veterinarian for their treatment
maintain cleanliness in the fattening pens, removing the animal and other waste regularly
monitor the fatteners and prevent them from scavenging
check the growth of fatteners and determine if they are mature for marketing
